context.exploration_scope: Extracted the real Goal->State->Gap->Experience->Decision->Outcome relationship for all 4 production-scoped goals from S0's naming lenses, using only real, already-existing fields

problem: S0 defined the Studio State Model's 7 entities as connection points but never traced an actual per-goal relationship through them -- without doing so, it was unverified whether the 'lens' design actually holds together end-to-end for real data, or only in the abstract.

Relationship integrity: goals_real=true, state_caps_real=true, gaps_real=true, experiences_real=true. Found 1 production goal(s) with 0 Gap/Experience provenance despite a "satisfied" state (goal_character_narrative_intelligence). 1 Studio Decision Candidate recorded: cand_studio_decision_s1_goal_character_narrative_intelligence_provenance_gap (not applied). 0 real PB/Goal/Gap/LPM/SSI/CHAR modifications, 0 automatic executions.

action.action_summary: Extracted the real Goal->State->Gap->Experience->Decision->Outcome chain for all production-scoped goals; verified every referenced id resolves to a real record; generated exactly 1 grounded Studio Decision Candidate from what the extraction itself surfaced.

result.note: Real asymmetry found and recorded as a candidate (not acted on): goal_character_narrative_intelligence has a satisfied capability status but 0 recorded decision provenance.

cause.root_cause_summary: A naming-lens design (S0) is only proven correct once real data is actually traced through it end-to-end; doing so here surfaced a genuine, previously-unnoticed provenance gap rather than a hypothetical one.

lesson: Extracting a real relationship chain, rather than just defining connection points, is what surfaces genuine asymmetries (like a 'satisfied' goal with zero decision provenance) that a purely structural design review would miss.
